t: This is Icarus, also called Icarus III, an outdoor sculpture from 1973 standing in Old Change Court in the City of London. It shows the figure from Greek myth, and it is by Michael Ayrton. Ayrton was a painter, printmaker, sculptor, critic, broadcaster and novelist, and his work often returned to flight, myths, mirrors and mazes. So Icarus suits him well: a story of flight, set among the offices of the City.
